cues.text: Hello everyone. I’m Jake Stevens and I’m your rep here at the hotel.
I’m sure you’ll all have a great time here.
Let me tell you a bit about what’s on offer, starting with the excursions available for
guests.
Dolphin watching is one thing you have to do while you’re here.
We organise daily trips for 35 euros, but there aren’t any places left for this
afternoon’s trip.
If you’re energetic, I’d recommend our forest walk.
It’s about seven kilometres and half way through you’ll be provided with a drink and
sandwiches.
On Thursdays we organise a cycle trip.
We’ll take you and your bike up to the top of Mount Larna and leave you to bike back.
It’s a 700-metre drop in 20 kilometres, so this isn’t really for inexperienced cyclists.
On our local craft tour you can find out about traditional activities on the island, and
the best thing is that it’s completely free.
The observatory trip includes a visit to Sunset Beach afterwards, where you can have a
dip in the ocean if you want.
Finally, there’s horse riding.
It’s a great experience if you’re a keen horseback rider, or even if you’ve never been on
a horse before.
At night, the number one attraction is Musical Favourites.
At the end the cast members come down from the stage and you’ll have a chance to chat
with them. It’s hugely popular, so it’s no good leaving it until the last minute.
There’s also the Castle Feast on Saturday evening.
You eat in the medieval way, using your hands instead of cutlery, and after watching the
dancers in the ballroom, you can join in as well if you want.
